sources.title: MiniCPM-o 4.5 | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-o is OpenBMB's series of on-device multimodal LLMs upgraded from MiniCPM-V. The 4.5 model takes text, images, video and audio and outputs both text and speech in an end-to-end way, with about 9B total parameters and performance comparable to Gemini 2.5 Flash on vision and speech tasks.
